{{Quote|Shoran tells me he found something of interest near his camp; a Jedi holocron.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=ShoranFound.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
A '''Jedi holocron''' was found during the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonization]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]. It held knowledge of an [[ancient grove]] and could generate [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] inside a [[Jedi temple/Legends|Jedi temple]]. Following its discovery in a [[Shoran's camp|camp]] belonging to the Wookiee [[Shoran]], the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] was retrieved by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and placed in a [[Jedi temple (Alaris Prime)|Jedi temple]] built specifically to hold it.

==Description==
{{Quote|A holocron is a priceless repository of ancient information. It should not be left lying in the wilderness.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=WhatIsholocron.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
A [[Jedi holocron/Legends|Jedi holocron]] was located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]. It had a circular [[Color/Legends|gray]] base, a blue sphere in its center, and three pointed prongs extending above the sphere from the base. The [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] contained knowledge of an [[ancient grove]] associated with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on Alaris Prime and had the ability to generate [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] when placed within a [[Jedi temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. It could only be held by [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals such as the Jedi.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
{{Quote|We need to build a Jedi temple to house the holocron.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=BuildATemple.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
During the [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonization]] of Alaris Prime by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]<ref name="GB" /> between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the holocron was discovered by the Wookiee [[Shoran]] in a gap in the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] inside his [[Shoran's camp|camp]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], an [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to the Wookiees, wanted the holocron secured and received permission from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to have the Wookiees build a [[Jedi temple (Alaris Prime)|temple]] in [[Chewbacca's camp]] to contain it. Once the temple had been built by workers under the Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], Jinn's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], arrived on Alaris Prime and traveled from Chewbacca's camp to Shoran's camp to gather the holocron. After the holocron was placed in the temple, it slowly generated nova crystals for Chewbacca.<ref name="GB" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
During the [[Battle for Alaris Prime]], where the Wookiees drove the illegitimate [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] presence from the moon, studies of the holocron revealed the details of the ancient grove, which was situated near a Wookiee [[Unidentified Wookiee base (fortress)|base]]. Jinn and the Wookiees broke through a line of [[Tree/Legends|trees]] to find the path to the grove. There, Jinn learned the ability of [[Jedi Concentration]], with which he could convert hostile buildings to the Wookiee side.<ref name="GB" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The holocron was first mentioned in [[Prima Games]]' [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] by [[Steven L. Kent]]<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;for the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> It appeared in the sixth level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, "Allies and Jedi," which teaches the player about the mechanic of collecting and storing holocrons. In the game, collecting every holocron on a map and holding them for 200 in-game days gives victory to the player, so in addition to the Jedi holocron, an inaccessible holocron was placed in the campaign level to prevent an alternate ending.<ref name="GB" />
